---
title: "$\\mathcal{O}(\\log N)$ Hash Transitions: Algorithm-Independent Verification in Append-Only Logs"
author:
  - name: Timothy DeHerrera
    affiliations:
      - name: Cyphrpunk LLC
    email: timothy@cyphrpunk.com
  - name: Zachary Collier
    affiliations:
      - name: Cyphrpunk LLC
    email: zach@cyphrpunk.com
abstract: |
  Authenticated append-only logs rely on cryptographic hashes for historical
  immutability. However, executing a hash transition on a live log
  traditionally forces a trilemma: fracturing the ledger into incompatible
  forks, accepting weakest-link algorithmic dependencies through chimeric
  constructions, or incurring a catastrophic $\mathcal{O}(N)$ retroactive
  compute penalty. We introduce the *Epoch Merkle Log* (EML), an append-only
  data structure that partitions algorithm lifecycles into discrete,
  null-padded chronological epochs over a shared RFC 9162 topology. The EML
  achieves strictly algorithm-independent verification---each hash
  algorithm's projection yields a complete, independently verifiable standard
  Merkle tree---while enabling $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ hash transitions with
  zero retroactive computation. We formalize the EML via an initial algebra
  with 9 equational laws and provide a production Rust implementation
  validated by property-based testing, fault injection, and complexity
  regression, demonstrating $\mathcal{O}(1)$ amortized appends,
  $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ proofs, and zero-overhead bandwidth compression via
  deterministic proof elision.
date: 2026-05-15
---
